summary: Validated SWARM-X Guardian public API, dashboard workflows, responsive layout, and Pygame syntax.
action_items: Keep PostgreSQL and MQTT adapters as the next production hardening work; current demo intentionally uses in-memory state and in-process transport fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: Simulation state is process-global and in-memory, so multiple dashboard clients share and mutate one demo mission; this is acceptable for the documented prototype but must be replaced or isolated for multi-user production.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created; API scenarios reset deterministic in-memory state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop and mobile dashboard flows passed: load, toggle, failure scenario, inspection, failure injection, task creation, and no horizontal overflow. All documented scenarios and API error paths passed. Pygame source compiles.
rca of the issue: The first regression run had one false failure because the dashboard and tests shared the process-global simulation and the test assumed a fresh normal scenario. The test now resets normal before asserting initial state; application behavior was not changed. PostgreSQL persistence and MQTT broker integration remain MOCKED/intentional fallback behavior.
